 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Abinash Kumar, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Dr. Ajeet Kumar, APP

==== =
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SOURENDRA PANDEY  ORAL ORDER 2 07-08-2025 Heard Mr. Abinash Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned APP for the State.

2. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the present application has been filed for quashing the FIR of Dhoraiya P.S. Case No. 79 of 2024 registered under Sections 406 and 420 of the IPC and Section 138 of the Negotiable Instrument Act.

3. It has been submitted that from mere perusal of the FIR, it would suffice that the petitioner has no role to play in the said transaction in which the informant has alleged that he was not the person who executed the cheque in favour of the informant and even the MOU which was entered with the Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.59166 of 2024(2) dt.07-08-2025 company, with which he has no concern.

4. In view of the above, let notice be issued to the opposite party no. 2 under registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process, subject to steps being taken by the petitioner within a period of two weeks from today.

5. Call for the legible carbon/photo copy of the case diary in connection with Dhoraiya P.S. Case No.
79 of 2024 from the court of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate III, Banka.
6.
